title: Update 15.3 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 15.3 for 2019 Release Wave 2 includes hotfixes and feature changes such as viewing reference and external document numbers on sales documents, skipping empty lines in account schedule reports, MICR fonts support, and sign-in attempt telemetry for partners.
features: Reference and external document numbers on sales documents
Skip empty lines in Account Schedule report
